pages.text: Hold a $(bold)sweaty boot in your main hand$() + an $(bold)empty glass bottle in your offhand$(), then $(bold)sneak + right-click$() to pour: you get one bottle per boot level, and the boots turn clean again.$(br2)Drinking a sweat bottle: level 1 restores half a hunger shank, level 2 nauseates for 10 s, level 3 poisons for 3 s.

$(bold)Fermented boots$() (leather boots + sugar) at level 3 pour a $(bold)Sweat Drink$(): grants Speed, Jump Boost, Strength and Luck for 30 s each.$(br2)Pouring clears Sweaty Feet (the boots are clean again) but $(bold)does not cure fungus$().
